tools.name: new_session
tools.description: Starts fresh session context and returns a new session_id. Reuse that ID on subsequent calls for continuity; changing or omitting it starts clean context.

tools.name: journal_log
tools.description: Log an action performed outside Zambo into an append-only job timeline. Zambo records the report and does not claim it ran or observed the action.

tools.name: leadsignal
tools.description: AI lead generation for contractors and local service businesses. Accepts a trade type and city. Returns qualified local leads with available contact information.

tools.name: provibe_audit
tools.description: AI code audit for a public GitHub repository. Returns a Provibe score from 0 to 100, security vulnerabilities, a dead-code map, and an execution plan for addressing the findings.

tools.name: ghost_audit_site
tools.description: Achilles 10-stage audit for a website. Returns SEO gaps, AI discoverability issues, conversion leaks, brand-presence gaps, competitor intelligence, a score from 0 to 100, stage findings, an audit ID, a live stream URL, and a report URL.

tools.name: ghost_audit_status
tools.description: Status report for a Ghost Audit identified by audit_id. Returns whether the audit is running or complete, along with elapsed-time information and report availability.

tools.name: ghost_audit_report
tools.description: Full markdown report for a completed Ghost Audit. Returns the Achilles 10-stage score, severity-ranked findings, stage analysis, and recommended fixes.

tools.name: credithunt
tools.description: Live verified index of AI and cloud startup credit programs. Accepts an optional technology stack and stage. Returns matching programs, eligibility details, current links, and available credit information.

tools.name: prompt_shield
tools.description: Detection and analysis of prompt injection, jailbreak, and policy-bypass attempts. Returns an injection risk score, a safe/review/block recommendation, attack indicators, and a safe rewritten version when available.

tools.name: day_pass_activate

tools.description: Search across the supported Zambo tool catalog for a use case. Returns relevant tools with relevance scores, descriptions, taglines, and callable API endpoints.
